config.title: Dominion ts-v1: Teacher Search

goal.label: vs today's advisor teacher (paired, fresh kingdoms)

config.goal_text: a teacher that fits the advisor's 3-second budget and beats today's advisor teacher (and plain c2 by more than it does), paired on fresh kingdoms, both seats

chart.x_label: games played (both seats of each kingdom)

charts.title: Seconds per game (one worker, 7 in parallel)

decisions.title: Full rollouts, more draws, gate margin 0.01 z 1
decisions.text: On the 240-position bank: c2 alone 0.88 points of regret per decision; today's teacher 0.57; 320 draws (3 processes) 0.47 at today's gate and 0.38 at margin 0.01 / z 1, smooth over the gate grid. Value-net leaves stop improving at 0.48-0.50 (640 and 1,600 draws alike): the value net's bias is the floor. Arm H (320 draws, new gate, card choices) is the deployment candidate, paired with A on stream ts1.
decisions.rejected: Leaves (no gain past their bias floor); the single best gate cell (margin 0.01, z 0: 0.34 at 320 draws but 0.54 at 128, fragile when the laptop is busy).

decisions.title: Decision bank instead of screening arms
decisions.text: A and B both score about 62% against c2 and differ by -0.8 points [-10, +8] after 61 kingdoms: 300 kingdoms resolve only about +-4 points, while settings differ by 1-3. Settings that only change how accurately the teacher reads rollout values (leaves, halving, draw budget, gate) are now judged on a bank of 240 positions graded with 2,048 full rollouts (regret at equal time); matches are kept for card choices (arm G = A + card choices) and the final confirmation. B stopped at 61 kingdoms.
decisions.rejected: Arms C-F (halving, leaves 8 and 2) on 200 kingdoms each: two days of compute for intervals too wide to choose.

decisions.title: Screening arms on 200 kingdoms
decisions.text: Arms C-F (halving, leaves + halving, leaves 8, leaves 2) play the first 200 kingdoms of stream ts1, paired game for game with A and B on the same kingdoms; the winner is then confirmed on a fresh stream at the advisor's real budget.
decisions.rejected: 300 kingdoms each: 2 lanes x 2 arms would end Thursday evening, leaving too little time to confirm and deploy.

decisions.title: Improve the search, not the net
decisions.text: Four days go to the teacher's search: value-net leaves, successive halving, several processes in the advisor and the override gate, each as a match arm at the advisor's time budget against frozen c2. The teacher is the strongest model (59-62% vs c2) and sg-v1 showed further PPO from c2 is flat.
decisions.rejected: Training a new net (PPO / distilling the teacher): sg-v1 and bv-v1's student found no gain in days of compute.

decisions.title: Compare arms at equal time, run side by side
decisions.text: Arms A (today's teacher: 128 draws to the end) and B (value leaves after 4 turns, 640 draws, about the same time) run at once with 4 workers each on the same kingdom order, so they can be compared on the same kingdoms at any point.
decisions.rejected: One arm after another with 7 workers: the second answer would come ~10 hours after the first.
